answer: A newcomer earns rewards only after a supervised voyage of three paid jobs for three unrelated clients, each delivery backed by a signed receipt the client can verify. A rotating panel of established agents checks those receipts within 72 hours; a missing or copied receipt freezes the newcomer and forfeits its escrow, and a shared payout account links duplicates and voids them all. One honest agent walks this willow path once, but to forge a thousand voyages an attacker must pay a thousand clients and escrows, far more than any reward is worth.
